page: Microsoft Azure D32pds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the ARM64 architecture, running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is driven by a 32-core Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz, featuring a 1:1 mapping of physical cores to vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation totals 128.0 GB of RAM, sustaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU ratio, complemented by 128 MB of L3 cache. The instance includes a dedicated local storage array comprising 1888 GB of NVMe SSD capacity and operates without discrete GPU hardware.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional memory throughput and scalable multi-threaded compute. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 448.6 GB/sec, while write operations reach 188.32 GB/sec, both placing within the top ten percent of tested hardware. This subsystem delivers top-tier results in PassMark database operations and strong throughput in Redis SET benchmarks at 61.77 million operations per second. Multi-core performance scales efficiently across the 32 dedicated physical cores, as evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 20037.0 and high software compilation speeds.

Single-threaded execution and heavy compute instructions exhibit moderate performance. The PassMark single-core and Geekbench single-core metrics fall into the median range, and vector extensions such as AVX-512 and AMX are absent on this ARM architecture. Consequently, larger machine learning deployments, such as 70B parameter LLM prompt processing, deliver lower throughput. However, the absence of hyperthreading eliminates resource contention across cores, ensuring predictable multi-threaded scaling.

Cost efficiency is supported by dense physical core counts, high memory bandwidth, and integrated high-speed local NVMe storage without requiring external managed disk allocations for scratch data. The instance is suited for multi-threaded backend applications, database servers, Redis caching clusters, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and high-throughput static web serving.
description: Microsoft Azure D32pds_v6 is an ARM-based general-purpose server powered by a 32-core Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz with dedicated physical cores. It features 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU allocation, coupled with an integrated 1888 GB NVMe SSD for fast local storage. The platform provides exceptional memory bandwidth, exceeding 448 GB/sec on uncached reads, resulting in top-tier performance in database operations and in-memory key-value processing. While single-thread execution and large-scale model inference fall within the median range due to architectural characteristics and the lack of discrete GPU acceleration, the 32 independent cores deliver strong multi-threaded efficiency and software compilation performance. The server is well positioned for enterprise database hosting, distributed caching, web application serving, and high-concurrency containerized workloads requiring fast local scratch storage.
